![](globe.jpg){fig-align="center" width="300"}

## Description

How can you determine the proportion of the Earth that is covered in water using only a globe? 

You may be tempted to start calculating complex areas, but the answer is much easier - we can use simple random sampling!

In this activity, students will throw around an inflatable globe to obtain random samples. There is also a simple, optional applet that can help you keep track and visualize the samples as you go. 

## Learning outcomes:

After the activity, students will be able to:

-  Define and recall the weak law of large numbers 

-  Identify a real application of the weak law of large numbers

## Directions

1. Set the scene: 

> Suppose you wash up on deserted island with no internet connection. A pirate appears and offers you the opportunity to catch a ride back with them to the nearest city so long as you can answer one question: **what proportion of the Earth's surface is water?** Unfortunately, you've bumped your head and cannot remember basic trivia. The pirate offers you a globe to assist in your answer. How can you get off of this island?


2.  Students will throw the ball around and indicate whether or not the point under their index finger is LAND or WATER. You can keep track of the LAND vs WATER count, stopping every so often to get the sample mean. You can also track it on this app here: [globe water tracker](https://shinylive.io/r/app/#h=0&--ldfC5bdxWldpj2VUEr3vZ9BjNa17WdetvUGP1L74wY2rkuLw1kchFEsNRzqCQxTFzTD8PU3yv4GPFRl-PstDwHjk3qMdxOnWAVM8hrJCU8bV3fLQSjcBEz29JWoUi2LIg6CMUQ65CphwpcrrNnwJPaRcpukCzzJ2CQAgGCA9QAMQGFBP46wYRl2bozKAi5vK+HKjkMuEUD1EXWXGGYKrp3AABqdnsPYpcYIkzDwApFc+NYEpSn8AR8OQiKfsh7hdzYrmoJVgosL2UQj865NBsQlzOy8Q-z-xaV2dJD5r4PcDD-xFs0w2AS91EbwLwm00Ipw6KcAAYr2vLqY-6KoqaKRkeLycGDScBqBT0hIkIO--L+pEhnVIMEVVARDfA13tBnLOsk4DOnHpwdgjB6B8GovYghCztIzI4QIcWlSFh-3RPYa4S9SHuS+BQAw9BPQARKDkJMbwADWcB7D1CIFIX2cAUg6zIOwUOnownnXHtpCx3R4HjxVoGD2Rjf4LBTiS64yZnjj0+N8LotKBxdGREyggrL2ULE5eqRgOteWxAFRAEmKwVVjlFQnZ0kqLQDFnFcWV8r3ApygqBClTkjVctNTyvlpNBWkBWCBH4YrEWISbi3NusAVlDjWb3TZA8yCH03p89BByAgz2YJMTNfjAwDMbOmo+NzHmSLTRvA0zzmmvIMBfRgV8RpfOWA-Z+kxX4tHfp-b+r4CUeoMCnImJNAr7Gyb6ph7gI7WuKUikh7EmL7DgHFdg4r3ALJIUi8hzDWEuM4QswRwj44qlIPkW8YBywe2-JwDAea54dAPbGuI+L6hyvqH-UdnpAqpKnRyk6YbxELoDkuqIK610bpLsQgOO7MksIMGwjhL6vHKKFqen4F6BjXsGgmNU96wj5sDCh4VxaAnOOQ0e7xg7P0Kq1oB39MN3mOiNYB0jFNmNdFAxQZdq7SZQa3bBmN8H92UYEWhkRBgz1YaCOeXD0U1TkHLCih81EFkrE4xR1xVGDAACpuaVm0qWMqQRiI0aJXR79pBApq0tuAtQGgAORw0--xnlgriawBHRKy0Ty0ISPJo2VEeO+nqsAE4grk7K4bm5Q3GuALXGkPkWQci9l0HZQKhviLaSMgAK10KMFoJhqtJ9q0Ngstu1wqnZY73nARdLcAr1XgIxnBf404O8burBd5kD4LoC4yKM8Y8OUP5kiBEDAJiGQbSMOvDqQICj7mVOct1ca8i63BgidmgtAYTE0e0mDdFpV56tnT5dFBH+hcl0r-4we6jaGC078dPRMqIgaFn8nISI6s-cCwdtVs+B9ZG5nB1RbB5c+dehQDyQdswZopjYjsvBUZnsCEjp2BChihnphJqBW9PtzAnhAE-tm17AMA1sWd0cztXtLtd1RZMlCV3AP0IBCURAeA+BWB0R0B2B9Bo5A1GBZAwAjFvEgA)
